ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution characterized by internal white regions and dark perimeters, with an approximate macro-level white-to-black pixel ratio of 45:55 across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large, high-intensity white contiguous areas are localized in the center of both the left and right lobes. These are surrounded by low-intensity black borders along the leading and trailing edges. The white region on the right lobe contains a significantly higher density of small, dark pixel clusters (mottling) compared to the left.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped median notch with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 60 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous, high-frequency serration along the entire trailing edge boundary, featuring irregular peaks and valleys with pixel-amplitudes ranging from roughly 5 to 15 pixels relative to the local mean edge line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge exhibits a sigmoidal curve, beginning with a concave sweep from the median notch and transitioning to a convex curve as it approaches the distal tips.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced asymmetry in the internal pigmentation patterns, specifically the higher concentration of dark spots within the white field of the right lobe.
